question: If in a code language, 'HOOK' is written as 'KUXW', then how will 'COKE' be written in the same code language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 'HOOK' is written as 'KUXW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08331ceb93e1e5a6f50105f29be766bdd58fa5f835ca78e2532e21ba756e5d2c.png] 

Similarly,

**'COKE'** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1553c007e798d12f7f16b1f73310640db643a34aa70622516cfc56b4c51729b1.png]
